End_Date_SUN_Report__c = Start_Date_SUN_Report__c,
TotalPrice,

),

IF(

End_Date_SUN_Report__c - Start_Date_SUN_Report__c + 1 =
IF(

AND(

MOD(YEAR(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c), 100) <> 0
)
),
366,
365
),
TotalPrice,
TotalPrice *
(
IF(
OR(
MOD(YEAR(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c), 400) = 0,
AND(
MOD(YEAR(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c), 4) = 0,
MOD(YEAR(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c), 100) <> 0
)
),
366,
365
)
/
(End_Date_SUN_Report__c - Start_Date_SUN_Report__c + 1)
)
),
0
)
)
)" to "IF(

        OR(
            ISBLANK(End_Date_SUN_Report__c),
            ISBLANK(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c)

        TotalPrice,

        IF(
            Segment_Index__c = 1,

            IF(
                End_Date_SUN_Report__c = ADDMONTHS(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c, 12) - 1,
                TotalPrice,
                TotalPrice *
                (
                    365 /
                    (End_Date_SUN_Report__c - Start_Date_SUN_Report__c + 1)
                )
            ),
            0
        )
    )
)"
